headline: "They will still be lower than in many cities": water and sewage tariffs to rise in Kharkiv | objectiv.tv
summary: Tariffs for centralized cold water supply and wastewater disposal in Kharkiv will rise in two stages, on October 1, 2026 and January 1, 2027. Officials say they remain lower than in many cities.
why: Utility tariff changes set the revenue base for regulated municipal water operators and affect household and business costs.
